subject: CareVista prepay structuring, PO header mandate & billing rhythm
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@carevista.health>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@carevista.health
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pricing — PO header fields & invoice cadence requirements

Hi Grace / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the overview last week. A couple of procurement constraints came up as we prepare our PO and I wanted to surface them early so we can align on structure and T&Cs. High level: CareVista requires (for ERP and audit purposes) that each invoice includes a) PO number in the invoice header and line items, b) our internal cost-center and BU codes (I will paste them below), and c) the vendor fiscal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.

We also need to settle on invoice cadence. Our AP prefers consolidated monthly invoices for any vendor with recurring usage, but we can accept up to two POs per calendar month if there are separate GL mappings they need. Net terms — our standard is Net 45, but there is some flexibility to Net 30 on approved contracts.

Can you confirm: 1) whether Redwood can place the PO number into the invoice header and onto line items, 2) whether you can emit consolidated monthly invoices (rather than weekly), and 3) options if we need to prepay a quarter in advance for a consumption discount?

Procurement details (for PO header mapping):
- Cost center: CV-OPS-311
- BU code: CV-CLINICAL
- AP contact: ap@carevista.health (Karen Liu)

Appreciate a short note with the options and any follow-up items we should expect.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Director, Strategic Procurement
CareVista Health

Attachment: none
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@carevista.health>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pricing — PO header fields & invoice cadence requirements

Hi Daniel — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers so procurement can plan: 1) Yes — we can include the PO number in the invoice header and as a reference on each billed line, 2) consolidated monthly invoices are our default for enterprise agreements and are fine here, and 3) we can offer prepay / committed commitment discounts (we typically map that as a credit schedule applied across monthly statements).

I'll loop Vanessa and Karthik for the exact packaging / discount math and to prepare a redlined order form that embeds the header mapping fields. Vanessa — can you outline two options: a) pay-as-you-go consolidated monthly with Net 45, and b) quarterly prepay at a 6% effective discount with Net 30 on the prepayment invoice? Also include any constraints around multiple POs in the same month (CareVista asked about up to two).

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Grace O'Connor
Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@carevista.health>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pricing — PO header fields & invoice cadence requirements

Hi Daniel — copying the short, actionable options below so procurement can share with AP. I kept the descriptions concise to make the PO and SOW lines straightforward.

Option A — Consolidated monthly, pay-as-you-go
- Invoicing: one consolidated invoice per calendar month aggregating all usage across products (single invoice PDF, PO number in header and on each line).
- Net terms: Net 45 (standard for self-serve and hosted).
- Discount: none on consumption; volume tiers apply automatically (no prepayment).
- Multiple POs: we can accept up to two PO numbers on a given month if you need separate GL mappings; each PO will be listed as a separate reference line.

Option B — Quarterly prepay (preferred for predictable spend)
- Structure: Customer prepays quarterly against an agreed commitment. We issue a single prepayment invoice per quarter (PO number required on that invoice).
- Net terms: Net 30 on the prepayment invoice (we can accommodate Net 30 for prepaid invoices).
- Effective discount: 6% off published list for the committed quarterly amount; unused committed dollars roll forward for one quarter only.
- Invoicing cadence during the quarter: Monthly statements showing consumption vs prepaid credit; no additional charge unless consumption exceeds prepay.

Other notes:
- PO header fields: we will include PO number, Cost Center (we can map to the BU code you provided), and Redwood legal entity on each invoice automatically.
- Attachments: I attached a sample order form (RW-Order-Form-CV142-draft.pdf) and the pricing schedule with tier thresholds (CareVista_pricing-schedule_v3.xlsx).

If either Net 30 vs Net 45 is a hard constraint for AP, let us know. Option B gives you the best unit economics and keeps the accounting simple; Option A is lowest friction if AP can't prepay.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RW-Order-Form-CV142-draft.pdf; CareVista_pricing-schedule_v3.xlsx
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@carevista.health>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@carevista.health, ap@carevista.health
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pricing — PO header fields & invoice cadence requirements

Thanks Vanessa — that helps. A few clarifications from AP / finance:
1) Consolidated monthly (Option A) is our default preference for recurring vendors unless there is a prepay. We will accept up to two PO numbers per month; ideally we'd like a single invoice with both PO references.
2) For Option B prepay: AP can do Net 30 on the prepaid invoice, but our legal team will need the commitment and rollover language in the order form (we don't want committed credit to disappear — 1-quarter roll-forward is OK but not past that).
3) One additional ask: can Redwood indicate the BU cost-center and our internal reference on the invoice PDF metadata (not just in the line text)? We use automated ingestion and that metadata makes mapping automatic.

If you can confirm the metadata export is possible (we can share the expected field names) and send a redlined order form that captures the rollover and prepay language, we can aim to issue the initial PO the week of Sep 7.

Regards,
Daniel
